Key Takeaways
Satish was asked to share his screen to discuss the Super K dashboard, which includes store names, towns, and districts.
The dashboard showed a 15% decrease in performance compared to the previous month, with specific metrics like MDD and store name filters discussed.
There was a focus on customer sales invoice items, including details like phone numbers and payment values, with an emphasis on filtering and summarizing data.
The team discussed summarizing data by grouping phone numbers and store names, and visualizing this information in a table format.
Customer retention and purchase frequency were analyzed, with a focus on metrics for December 2023 and January 2024.
